description: We are a group of passionate and curious students interested in space exploration, science and technology. We believe in learning, creativity and teamwork to turn innovative ideas into meaningful solutions. We welcome enthusiastic individuals who are interested in coding, research, design, problem-solving and space science. Beginners are welcome! Let's collaborate, learn and create something extraordinary together.
summary:
MISSION MARS – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive educational survival game designed to introduce players to the challenges of living and working on Mars. Players take on the role of a junior astronaut and experience mission-based challenges that require them to make decisions, manage resources, and overcome obstacles in a simulated Martian environment.

The project aims to make space science more engaging and accessible, especially for young learners. By combining gaming with educational content, it helps players understand the difficulties of Mars exploration, including survival, resource management, and mission safety.

MISSION MARS addresses the challenge by transforming complex concepts of Mars exploration into an interactive learning experience. It encourages curiosity, critical thinking, and problem-solving while inspiring the next generation to explore space and learn more about future human missions to Mars.
details:
MISSION MARS – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is a browser-based educational survival game that introduces players to the challenges of human exploration on Mars.

The player takes the role of an astronaut on a Martian mission. They can explore a simulated Mars base, interact with five important stations: Life Support, Solar Array, Greenhouse, Radiation Shelter, and Earth Communication. The game includes resource management involving oxygen, power, food, water, and radiation safety. Players progress through a 10-Sol mission, respond to random events, complete objectives, and try to keep the mission successful. It also includes educational explanations to help players understand the science behind Mars exploration.

The main benefit of this project is that it makes space science more interactive and accessible, particularly for young learners. It encourages critical thinking, decision-making, resource management, and curiosity about space exploration.

Our creative approach was to turn the challenges of a Mars mission into a playable learning experience rather than presenting them only as theoretical information. We considered the importance of limited resources, astronaut safety, mission duration, and the difficulties of communication between Earth and Mars.

TECHNOLOGIES USED:
The project was developed as a browser-based application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It does not require additional hardware or external installations. GitHub was used for source-code hosting, and GitHub Pages was used to make the project publicly accessible.

Our intended impact is to inspire students to learn about planetary science, engineering, and the future possibilities of human exploration beyond Earth.
